$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

setNotesTextOp.description: 只改备注页上占位符 p:ph/@type 为 body 的那个文本框。
setNotesTextOp.descriptionEn: Change only the text box on the notes page whose placeholder p:ph/@type is body.
setNotesTextOp.limits: 文档顺序中第一个 body 占位符命中。找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是上述两种报 InvalidId。
setNotesTextOp.limitsEn: The first body placeholder in document order is the one that matches. A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not one of those two kinds returns InvalidId.

insertSlideOp.limits: pptx：id 不是 pptx:presentation 报 InvalidId。after 找不到报 IdNotFound；不是页 id 报 InvalidId。 新建空白幻灯片部件（p:spTree 只有组合框，不抄版式占位符，不写 <p:timing>），关系指向一份已有 slideLayout：优先抄 after 那一页的版式关系，省略 after 则抄最后一页；该页没有版式关系则用第一份幻灯片母版的第一份版式。 找不到任何版式报 InvalidField。p:sldId/@id 取已有最大 ST_SlideId 加 1，至少为 256。
insertSlideOp.limitsEn: pptx: an id that is not pptx:presentation returns InvalidId. A missing after returns IdNotFound. An after that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. Create a blank slide part (p:spTree contains only the group shape, layout placeholders are not copied, and <p:timing> is not written). The relationship points at an existing slideLayout: prefer the layout relationship of the after slide; if after is omitted, copy the last slide's; if that slide has no layout relationship, use the first layout of the first slide master. If no layout can be found, the op returns InvalidField. p:sldId/@id is the largest existing ST_SlideId plus 1, and at least 256.

deleteSlideOp.limits: 找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。删掉演示文稿里最后一页报 InvalidField，不写文件。 去掉 sldIdLst 表项、presentation 关系、内容类型，以及该页部件及其 .rels。该页备注 notesSlide、现代批注部件、图表 / embedding / diagram / 媒体若再无人引用则删。 不删幻灯片版式、母版、主题、notesMaster。
deleteSlideOp.limitsEn: A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. Deleting the last slide in the presentation returns InvalidField, and the file is not written. Remove the sldIdLst entry, the presentation relationship, the content type, and that slide part and its .rels. That slide's notesSlide, modern comment part, and chart / embedding / diagram / media are deleted if nothing else references them. Slide layouts, masters, the theme, and notesMaster are not deleted.

moveSlideOp.description: 调整一张幻灯片的顺序。
moveSlideOp.limits: 找不到该页或 after 报 IdNotFound。id / after 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。after 与 id 是同一页报 InvalidField。已经在目标位置则空操作。 只改 presentation.xml 里 sldIdLst 子元素顺序，以及若有 p14:sectionLst 则按同一套顺序把该 ST_SlideId 挪到 after 那一页所在节（移到最前则进第一节）。 不改部件路径、p:sldId/@id 或关系 id。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
moveSlideOp.limitsEn: A missing slide or a missing after returns IdNotFound. An id or after that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. after equal to id returns InvalidField. If it is already at the target position, the op is a no-op. Only the order of sldIdLst children in presentation.xml changes. If p14:sectionLst is present, move that ST_SlideId, by the same order, into the section that contains the after slide (moving it to the front puts it in the first section). Part paths, p:sldId/@id, and relationship ids are unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideHiddenOp.description: 隐藏或显示一张幻灯片。
setSlideHiddenOp.limits: 找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。缺 hidden 报 InvalidField。true 在该页 p:sld 上写 show="0"。 false 去掉 show。已经是目标可见性则空操作。允许把全部页藏起来。不改 sldIdLst。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlideHiddenOp.limitsEn: A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. A missing hidden returns InvalidField. true writes show="0" on that slide's p:sld. false removes show. If visibility is already the target, the op is a no-op. Hiding every slide is allowed. sldIdLst is unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideLayoutOp.description: 只改该页 .rels 里指向 slideLayout 的关系。
setSlideLayoutOp.descriptionEn: Change only the relationship in that slide's .rels that points at a slideLayout.
setSlideLayoutOp.limits: 不改幻灯片 XML，不删用户形状，不把版式占位符抄进页，不写 <p:timing>。
setSlideLayoutOp.limitsEn: Slide XML is unchanged. User shapes are not deleted. Layout placeholders are not copied onto the slide. <p:timing> is not written.

insertLayoutOp.description: 在已有母版上追加一份空白版式。
insertLayoutOp.descriptionEn: Append a blank layout to an existing master.
insertLayoutOp.limits: 不抄占位符，不算母版排版引擎。
insertLayoutOp.limitsEn: Placeholders are not copied. This is not a master layout engine.

deleteLayoutOp.limits: 找不到该版式报 IdNotFound。id 不是版式 id 报 InvalidId。任何页的 layoutId 指向它则报 InvalidField，未写文件。该母版只剩这一份版式报 InvalidField。 摘掉母版 p:sldLayoutIdLst 对应项、母版 .rels 对应关系、该 slideLayout 部件及其 .rels、内容类型 Override。不改各页 XML，不改未点名版式。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteLayoutOp.limitsEn: A missing layout returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a layout id returns InvalidId. If any slide's layoutId points at it, the op returns InvalidField and the file is not written. If that master has only this layout left, the op returns InvalidField. Remove the matching entry in the master's p:sldLayoutIdLst, the matching relationship in the master's .rels, that slideLayout part and its .rels, and the content-type Override. Slide XML is unchanged, and layouts you did not name are unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

insertPlaceholderOp.description: 往母版或版式插入一个带 p:ph 与 p:txBody 的占位符。
insertPlaceholderOp.descriptionEn: Insert a placeholder that has p:ph and p:txBody on a master or layout.
insertPlaceholderOp.limits: 装饰形请用 insertShape。不写 theme p:style，不写 a16:creationId。可写 title、body、ctrTitle、subTitle、dt、ftr、sldNum、hdr、obj、chart、tbl、pic、media，以及备注母版上的 sldImg。
insertPlaceholderOp.limitsEn: For a decorative shape, use insertShape. Do not write a theme p:style or a16:creationId. Writable types are title, body, ctrTitle, subTitle, dt, ftr, sldNum, hdr, obj, chart, tbl, pic, media, and sldImg on the notes master.

deletePlaceholderOp.limits: 找不到该占位符报 IdNotFound。id 不是占位符 id 报 InvalidId。对幻灯片形状 id 发本 op 报 InvalidId。只删该 p:sp。 若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。组合里的占位符同样摘掉；组合空了则把空 p:grpSp 一并摘掉。 不改各页 XML，不改未点名占位符的 cNvPr/@id。不把备注母版 / 讲义的删除抄进 notesSlide 或各页。 docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deletePlaceholderOp.limitsEn: A missing placeholder returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a placeholder id returns InvalidId. A slide shape id returns InvalidId for this op. Only that p:sp is deleted. If it sits in the Choice of an mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. A placeholder inside a group is removed the same way. If the group is then empty, the empty p:grpSp is removed too. Slide XML is unchanged, and cNvPr/@id of placeholders you did not name is unchanged. A delete on the notes master or handout is not copied into notesSlide or onto slides. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

insertMasterOp.description: 抄现有一份母版及其全部版式与 theme 部件，新开 master / layout / theme。
insertMasterOp.descriptionEn: Copy an existing master together with all of its layout and theme parts, and open new master / layout / theme parts.
insertMasterOp.limits: 不生成新的占位符几何，不算母版排版引擎。
insertMasterOp.limitsEn: New placeholder geometry is not generated. This is not a master layout engine.

deleteMasterOp.limits: 找不到该母版报 IdNotFound。id 不是母版 id 报 InvalidId（对 master:{n}/layout:{k} 或占位符 id 也是这条）。最后一份母版报 InvalidField。 任何页仍使用该母版下的版式报 InvalidField，未写文件。摘掉 presentation 的 p:sldMasterId 与对应关系， 以及该母版、其全部版式、仅被它引用的 theme 部件及其 .rels 与内容类型 Override。 不改各页 XML。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteMasterOp.limitsEn: A missing master returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a master id returns InvalidId (a master:{n}/layout:{k} id or a placeholder id returns this same error). The last remaining master returns InvalidField. If any slide still uses a layout under that master, the op returns InvalidField and the file is not written. Remove the presentation's p:sldMasterId and its relationship, plus that master, all of its layouts, theme parts referenced only by it, their .rels, and the content-type Overrides. Slide XML is unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideSizeOp.limits: 不按新画布重排已有形状，不算排版引擎。不改 p:notesSz。
setSlideSizeOp.limitsEn: Existing shapes are not rearranged onto the new canvas. This is not a layout engine. p:notesSz is unchanged.

setNotesSizeOp.limits: 不按新画布重排已有备注形状，不算排版引擎。不改 p:sldSz。
setNotesSizeOp.limitsEn: Existing notes shapes are not rearranged onto the new canvas. This is not a layout engine. p:sldSz is unchanged.

setHandoutTextOp.description: 改讲义上的页眉页脚文字。
setHandoutTextOp.descriptionEn: Change header and footer text on the handout.
setHandoutTextOp.limits: 四个槽位至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。未点名的槽位留下。id 不是 handout 报 InvalidId。 不要和 setNotesText 混用：本 op 只改 /ppt/handoutMasters/…，不改 notesSlide。 对 handout 容器发 setShapeText / setShapeFormat / insertShape / deleteShape / setShapeFill / setShapeLine / setShapeGeom 报 InvalidId。
setHandoutTextOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of the four slots, or the op returns InvalidField. Slots you did not name stay. An id that is not handout returns InvalidId. Do not mix this with setNotesText: this op changes only /ppt/handoutMasters/…, not notesSlide. setShapeText / setShapeFormat / insertShape / deleteShape / setShapeFill / setShapeLine / setShapeGeom on the handout container returns InvalidId.

insertSlideSectionOp.description: 在 p:sldIdLst 之上写入 p14:sectionLst 分组。
insertSlideSectionOp.descriptionEn: Write a p14:sectionLst grouping over p:sldIdLst.
insertSlideSectionOp.limits: 不改页部件。不写节的 UI 颜色。
insertSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: Slide parts are unchanged. Section UI color is not written.

setSlideSectionNameOp.descriptionEn: Change the name of a slide section.
setSlideSectionNameOp.limits: 找不到该节报 IdNotFound。id 不是节 id 报 InvalidId。只改 p14:section/@name。不改 GUID、不改所含页。xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlideSectionNameOp.limitsEn: A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a section id returns InvalidId. Only p14:section/@name changes. The GUID is unchanged, and the slides in the section are unchanged. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

deleteSlideSectionOp.limits: 找不到该节报 IdNotFound。id 不是节 id 报 InvalidId。页留在 sldIdLst，不删幻灯片部件。该节里的 ST_SlideId 并进前一节（删的是第一节则并进后一节）。 只剩这一节时去掉整份 p14:sectionLst；若该 p:ext 里没有别的子元素则连 p:ext 一起去掉。空的 p:extLst 也去掉。xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a section id returns InvalidId. Slides stay in sldIdLst. Slide parts are not deleted. ST_SlideId values in that section merge into the previous section (if the first section is deleted, they merge into the next one). When only this section remains, remove the whole p14:sectionLst. If that p:ext has no other children, remove p:ext with it. An empty p:extLst is removed too. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

setSlideSectionOp.descriptionEn: Move one slide into a section.
setSlideSectionOp.limits: 节必须覆盖 sldIdLst 的一个连续分段。
setSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: A section must cover one contiguous span of sldIdLst.
